name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes without blowing out edges, which current upscalers mangle. The trade-off is a 15% slower render time, but the visual gain is worth it for high-stakes frames.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting effort on a dead end while the core problem (motion blur) remains untouched. Test VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution first; if it ghosts on high-motion scenes, fall back to a hybrid pipeline with frame interpolation before upscaling—then measure the 0.5% gain with before/after A/B tests on the same clip.
